name: open-semantic-lab/mw-json
description: Storing and editing of structured data based on MultiContentRevisions, json, json-schema and json-ld.
_comment_require: All of the above are already present in MediaWiki core's vendor/ on a stock
OSL stack (lightncandy via core, ml/json-ld via SemanticMediaWiki), so no
deployment step is needed for them. Any dependency NOT already in core's
vendor/ must additionally be registered in the wiki's composer.local.json
merge-plugin include list. That is how extensions/WSSlots, ExternalData etc.
get theirs. See the JSON Schema note in docs/library-choices.md.
